newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Superfos buys small U.S. contractor.
newsitem.headline: Danish Superfos buys small U.S. contractor.

text.p: Danish construction and chemicals group Superfos said on Wednesday it acquired U.S. NWF Contractors for an undisclosed sum.
It said that NWF Contractors, based in Fort Walton, Florida had an annual turnover of $9 million with a staff of 85.
NWF surfaces and builds roads, pavements, draining systems and constructs concrete elements for local and state authorities and the military in the United States.

Superfos said in a statement that the acquisition was in line with its Superfos Construction US unit's strategy of strengthening its market position in the American states of Florida, Georgia, Alabama, Oklahoma and Kansas. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
